nodes.name: Daily Cron — 5am UTC
nodes.notes: Crawl runs daily at 05:00 in the workflow timezone (set in Settings). Digest fan-out is gated to Mondays only by the Weekly-Digest IF node.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  page_id,
  competitor_name,
  page_type,
  url,
  last_content_hash,
  last_content_text,
  last_seen_at
FROM competitor_tracked_pages
WHERE active = true
ORDER BY competitor_name, page_type
LIMIT 200;

nodes.name: Pull Tracked Pages
nodes.notes: Source-of-truth table for the tracked-pages list. Twenty to thirty rows is typical; cap at 200 to fail closed if the list grows unmanageably.

nodes.name: Iterate One Page At A Time
nodes.notes: Batch size 1 — each iteration handles one URL so per-page failure does not abort the run. Pair with a Wait node downstream to throttle.

nodes.name: Throttle — 4s Between Fetches
nodes.notes: Spreads ~30 fetches over ~2 minutes. Combined with one-request-per-page-per-day this keeps us well under any reasonable rate limit.

nodes.name: Fetch Page HTML
nodes.notes: neverError:true so a 403/503 from anti-bot does not kill the batch — we record it and move on.

nodes.name: Material Change?
nodes.notes: Four-part gate: fetch succeeded, hash differs, we have a prior snapshot to compare against, and length delta exceeds 0.5% (filters out single-character or whitespace-only edits).

nodes.name: Claude — Diff + Summarize
nodes.notes: Snapshots truncated to 6000 chars each — keeps input ≤ ~3k tokens per page. NO_CHANGE sentinel is the model's escape hatch when the diff is noisy.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO competitor_change_log (
  page_id, competitor_name, page_type, url,
  content_hash, summary, is_material, detected_at
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, now())
RETURNING id;

UPDATE competitor_tracked_pages
SET
  last_content_hash = $5,
  last_content_text = $8,
  last_seen_at = now()
WHERE page_id = $1;

nodes.name: Persist Change + Update Snapshot
nodes.notes: Two statements: append to the change log (audit trail), then advance the snapshot. is_material flag drives the weekly digest filter.

parameters.query:
UPDATE competitor_tracked_pages
SET
  last_content_hash = COALESCE($2, last_content_hash),
  last_content_text = COALESCE($3, last_content_text),
  last_seen_at = now()
WHERE page_id = $1;

nodes.name: Touch Snapshot (No Material Change)
nodes.notes: False branch: still advances the stored hash so the next run compares against the latest content, but does NOT spend a Claude call or write to the change log.

nodes.name: Weekly Digest Cron — Mon 14:30
nodes.notes: Independent trigger. Mondays at 14:30 in the workflow timezone — Tuesday morning for APAC, mid-morning for EU, breakfast for the US east coast.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  competitor_name,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'page_type', page_type,
      'url', url,
      'summary', summary,
      'detected_at', detected_at
    ) ORDER BY detected_at DESC
  ) AS changes
FROM competitor_change_log
WHERE is_material = true
  AND detected_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY competitor_name
ORDER BY competitor_name;

nodes.name: Aggregate Last 7 Days Of Material Changes
Anything To Report?
nodes.notes: Silent weeks stay silent — no 'no updates this week' filler messages. The channel never fires unless there is something actually worth reading.

nodes.name: Slack — Post Weekly Digest
nodes.notes: One message per competitor, not one mega-post — sales reps mute long unbroken digests. Update channel name to your team's actual channel.

nodes.name: On-Demand Webhook (Slack Slash Command)
nodes.notes: Wire a Slack slash command (e.g. /whatsnew acme) to this URL. Slack POSTs form-encoded body with text=<competitor query>.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  competitor_name,
  page_type,
  url,
  summary,
  detected_at
FROM competitor_change_log
WHERE is_material = true
  AND lower(competitor_name) LIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  AND detected_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY detected_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
